text:
Nora (Finance): Heads up 127 Labs requested a manual credit after a promo code failed to apply on their Mar invoice INV-2026-0510-3344. Ticket SUP-5032. They want a $300 promotional credit + confirmation that future invoices will include the commit discount.

Ivy (Support): Customer said they redeemed PROMO-MAR2026 at checkout but ledger shows no promo applied. Attached checkout screenshot and order id ord_9921.

Omar (Engineering): Quick check: checkout logs show promo redemption event but promo id not included in billing export due to a transient queue timeout at 2026-05-01T03:12:14Z.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0510-3344 total $4,720.00, expected $4,420.00 with promo applied. Suggested adjustment ADJ-8512 for $300 credit and flag promo application bug.

Cliora (Sales): 127 Labs is on a small commitment plan. Recommend issuing $300 one-time credit and provide a 1-month free support upgrade as gesture. Finance sign-off required for the non-monetary add-on.

Nora (Finance): Approve the $300 manual credit under ADJ-8512. For the support upgrade, ok from finance as goodwill, but log it in CRM. Please mark ADJ-8512 non-recurring and include memo: "promo redemption failed - one-time credit".

Omar (Engineering): Will post adjustment with: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-0510-3344","amount":-300,"reason":"promo redemption failed","code":"ADJ-8512"}`. Also creating bug CH-1187 for the queue timeout.

Ivy (Support): Customer notified: "We've queued a $300 credit and applied a one-month support upgrade. Expect invoice update in 2-4 business days." Customer replied :thanks:. Ticket SUP-5032 updated.

Billing Bot: ADJ-8512 posted to ledger on 2026-05-02. Invoice updated; PROMO-MAR2026 flagged as applied. Notification email scheduled.
